builderList.title: Class routine
builderList.emptyExplanation: This class has no sections yet.
builderList.subtitle: Pick a class, open a section, then arrange its weekly routine.
builderList.noClassesExplanation: Add a class and its sections first.
builderList.error: Couldn't load the classes. Check your connection and try again.

builder.title: {{className}} – {{sectionName}}
builder.noClassIdExplanation: Open this page from the class routine list so we know which section it is.
builder.noShiftExplanation: This class has no shift assigned yet — set one on the class before building its routine.
builder.noRoutineExplanation: No routine exists yet for this academic year.
builder.keyboardHint: Click a cell, or move with the arrow keys and press Enter. Delete clears a cell.
builder.sectionNotFoundExplanation: It may have been removed. Pick it again from the list.

cellPicker.title: Assign a period
cellPicker.description: Pick a subject, one or more teachers, and how often this repeats.

codes.BREAK_SLOT: A period can't go into a break.
codes.TEACHER_DOUBLE_BOOKED: A teacher on this period is already teaching another section at this time.
codes.SECTION_DOUBLE_BOOKED: This section already has a period at this time.
codes.ROOM_DOUBLE_BOOKED: This room is already in use at this time.
codes.TEACHER_OVER_DAILY_LIMIT: This would put a teacher over their daily period limit.
codes.TEACHER_NOT_ASSIGNED: This teacher isn't assigned to this subject for this section.
codes.TEACHER_OVER_CONSECUTIVE_LIMIT: A teacher would teach more periods in a row than the limit.
codes.unknown: This breaks one of the routine rules.

fillAssist.title: Fill remaining periods
fillAssist.description: Preview only — nothing is saved until you confirm. Already-filled cells are never touched.

review.title: Routine review
review.noRoutineExplanation: No routine exists yet for this academic year.
review.notATeacherExplanation: No teacher record found for your account — nothing to show here.

error.message: Could not load the routine. Check your connection and try again.

banner.draft: Draft — only you (the routine's builder) can see this.
banner.review: In review — teachers can see their own periods.

review.requestChangeDisabledExplanation: Change requests can only be raised once the routine is published.
review.copyYearDialogExplanation: Copies every slot into a new draft routine for the target academic year. Sections or subjects that don't exist in the target year are reported, not silently dropped.

changeRequestDialog.title: Request a change
changeRequestDialog.description: Tell the routine's builder what needs to change — they decide how to resolve it.
changeRequestDialog.notePlaceholder: e.g. This clashes with another of my periods.

changeRequestList.title: Change requests
changeRequestList.acceptDoesNotEditExplanation: Accepting a request does not edit the routine — the reshuffle usually touches other slots too, so make that change deliberately in the routine table.
changeRequestList.loadError: Could not load change requests. Check your connection and try again.

publishDialog.title: Publish this routine
publishDialog.oneWayExplanation: Publishing is one-way — there is no unpublish action anywhere in this system.
publishDialog.correctionsExplanation: Any correction after publishing is a new, dated edit through the routine table, not a rollback.

substitutionsPage.title: Substitute teachers
substitutionsPage.emptyExplanation: No cover or cancellation recorded for this filter.

myRoutine.title: My routine
myRoutine.notATeacherExplanation: Your account isn't linked to a teacher, so there are no periods to show.
myRoutine.noRoutineExplanation: The school hasn't published a routine yet.

error.message: Could not load your routine. Check your connection and try again.

myRoutine.subtitle: Your periods today and over the next 6 days.

substitutionDialog.title: Record a substitute teacher
substitutionDialog.description: Records a cover or a cancellation for one slot on one date — the weekly routine itself is never changed.
